items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Of course, I don't know Bechet. ... I've heard his records, but I don't know him. Never saw him.

ctx.x: I'm going to finish telling you about Fritz. Oh, yes. Fritz was a man. If we had a break in his song, and Fritz didn't hardly ever was familiar with the song, we'd tell him, so watch out, Fritz, you've got a break, and Fritz's going to come out with a sweeter break than what we made. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Fritz was something like Bechet. Of course, I don't know Bechet.
This fellow that died. I knew he was in New York, is all I knew he might have. I don't know him. Eight years.
